Clarity is a web-based supply chain finance platform built to solve a
measurable, documented cash-flow crisis faced by Bangladeshi SMEs
typically local suppliers of goods to large corporations. These suppliers wait 90 to 120 days to receive payment
on confirmed invoices, while borrowing from informal moneylenders at over
31% annually just to keep operations running. The platform connects three types of

on short-term, asset-backed receivables. Clarity earns a 0.5 to 1% facilitation fee on every funded invoice, creating a fully self-sustaining business model.
